headline.bm: Demokrat memenangi Senat AS menurut pengumuman AP dan menguasai kedua-dua dewan menurut unjuran rangkaian, tamparan besar buat Trump, dan saham teknologi Asia merosot dengan Nikkei turun kira-kira 3.5%. Pengawal Revolusi Iran mendakwa empat kapal tangki terbakar berhampiran Hormuz dengan Brent kembali melebihi $104, Israel buntu selepas pilihan raya, dan Rusia membedil Ukraine beberapa hari sebelum rundingan Abu Dhabi.
headline.en: Democrats have won the US Senate on an AP call and hold both chambers on network projections, a heavy blow to Trump, and Asian tech stocks are sliding with the Nikkei down about 3.5%. Iran's Guards claim four tankers are ablaze near Hormuz with Brent back above $104, Israel is deadlocked after its election, and Russia is pounding Ukraine days before Abu Dhabi talks.

summary.bm: AP mengumumkan Senat kepada Demokrat lewat Selasa selepas Josh Turek menang di Iowa, dan NBC News mengunjurkan Demokrat menguasai sepenuhnya Kongres; Scripps melaporkan majoriti Senat sekurang-kurangnya 51-49 berbanding kelebihan Republikan 53-47 sebelum ini. Forbes menyenaraikan kerusi yang beralih termasuk Iowa, Kansas, Ohio, North Carolina dan New Hampshire, manakala Reuters turut melaporkan kemenangan di Texas dan South Carolina. Pengumuman AP bagi Dewan Perwakilan tidak dapat disahkan dalam laporan yang disemak. Tinjauan keluar pusat mengundi SSRS yang dipetik Reuters menunjukkan 70% pengundi mahu Kongres lebih mengawal presiden.
summary.en: The AP called the Senate for Democrats late Tuesday after Josh Turek won Iowa, and NBC News projects full Democratic control of Congress; Scripps reports at least a 51-49 Senate majority against the Republicans' earlier 53-47 edge. Forbes lists flips including Iowa, Kansas, Ohio, North Carolina and New Hampshire, while Reuters also reports wins in Texas and South Carolina. An AP call on the House could not be confirmed in the reports reviewed. SSRS exit polls cited by Reuters show 70% of voters want Congress to provide more checks on the president.

title.bm: Demokrat menang Senat AS menurut pengumuman AP dan menguasai Dewan Perwakilan menurut unjuran rangkaian, tamparan besar buat Trump
title.en: Democrats win the US Senate on AP call and take the House on network projections, a major setback for Trump

why.bm: Kongres dikuasai Demokrat boleh menyekat agenda Trump untuk dua tahun terakhirnya dan menekan beliau tentang tarif, perbelanjaan dan perang Iran, yang semuanya memberi kesan kepada perdagangan, kos bahan api dan pasaran Malaysia.
why.en: A Democratic Congress can block Trump's agenda for his final two years and press him on tariffs, spending and the Iran war, all of which feed into Malaysian trade, fuel costs and markets.

summary.bm: Pengawal Revolusi Iran mendakwa empat kapal tangki musnah akibat periuk api laut di selatan Hormuz dan dua kapal dirampas, dakwaan yang belum disahkan secara bebas; UKMTO secara berasingan melaporkan dua projektil mengenai bilik enjin sebuah kapal tangki berhampiran Limah, Oman, tanpa kecederaan. Ketua keselamatan Mohsen Rezaei menyifatkan jawapan AS terhadap tujuh syarat Iran sebagai "tidak meyakinkan", dan seorang pegawai kanan memberitahu Reuters kedua-dua pihak masih jauh berbeza, manakala Qatar berkata rundingan tidak langsung diteruskan. Trump mengesahkan "serangan kecil" ke atas tapak antipesawat, dilaporkan di Qeshm, dan media AS menyatakan rancangan Komando Pusat boleh bermula seawal Rabu, tanpa keputusan dilaporkan. Brent naik 0.8% kepada $104.42 pada 0510 GMT, dibantu kejatuhan stok minyak mentah API sebanyak 5.27 juta tong.
summary.en: Iran's Revolutionary Guards say four oil tankers were destroyed by naval mines south of Hormuz and two vessels seized, claims not independently verified; UKMTO separately reported two projectiles hitting a tanker's engine room near Limah, Oman, with no casualties. Security chief Mohsen Rezaei called the US reply to Iran's seven conditions "unconvincing", and a senior official told Reuters the sides remain far apart, while Qatar says indirect talks continue. Trump confirmed a "minor attack" on an anti-aircraft site, reportedly on Qeshm, and US media say Central Command plans could start as early as Wednesday, with no decision reported. Brent was up 0.8% at $104.42 at 0510 GMT, helped by a 5.27m-barrel API crude draw.

title.bm: Pengawal Revolusi Iran dakwa empat kapal tangki terbakar selepas melanggar periuk api berhampiran Hormuz; perjanjian dengan AS masih jauh, minyak kembali melebihi $104
title.en: Iran's Guards say four tankers ablaze after hitting mines near Hormuz; US deal still far off and oil back above $104

why.bm: Qatar berusaha mengelakkan peningkatan konflik selepas PRU pertengahan penggal AS. Hasilnya menentukan harga minyak, sekali gus bil subsidi bahan api, inflasi dan hasil Petronas di Malaysia.
why.en: Qatar is trying to avert renewed escalation after the US midterms. The outcome drives oil prices, and with them Malaysia's fuel subsidy bill, inflation and Petronas revenue.

summary.bm: Zelenskiy berkata sekurang-kurangnya 33 orang terbunuh apabila Rusia dua kali menyerang sekolah yang digunakan untuk agihan bantuan di Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia, dengan kira-kira 50 orang dikhuatiri tertimbus; Moscow mendakwa menyasarkan unit tentera. Semalaman Rusia melancarkan 289 dron, 17 peluru berpandu balistik dan 59 peluru berpandu jelajah, memutuskan bekalan elektrik secara meluas dan melumpuhkan tiga daripada lima loji haba DTEK. Rundingan anjuran AS dijadualkan di Abu Dhabi pada 10–11 Nov, pusingan pertama dengan pengantaraan AS sejak Februari, namun Merz dari Jerman berkata beliau tidak melihat tanda Rusia serius.
summary.en: Zelenskiy said at least 33 people were killed when Russia twice struck a school used for aid distribution in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia, with about 50 feared buried; Moscow says it hit military units. Overnight Russia launched 289 drones, 17 ballistic and 59 cruise missiles, cutting power widely and knocking out three of DTEK's five thermal plants. US-brokered talks are set for Abu Dhabi on Nov 10–11, the first US-mediated round since February, though Germany's Merz says he sees no sign of Russian seriousness.

title.bm: Rusia bedil grid elektrik Ukraine dan pusat bantuan di sekolah, beberapa hari sebelum rundingan Abu Dhabi
title.en: Russia pounds Ukraine's power grid and a school aid centre days before Abu Dhabi talks

why.bm: Laluan gencatan senjata yang meyakinkan akan meredakan harga tenaga dan bijirin global; kegagalan pula mengekalkan Eropah dalam keadaan perang.
why.en: A credible ceasefire path would ease global energy and grain prices; a breakdown keeps Europe on a war footing.

summary.bm: Empat sumber tentera yang dipetik Reuters menyatakan Houthi kini dalam lingkungan 80km dari Aden, paling hampir sejak 2015, sekali gus mengancam jalan ke Taiz yang dikepung. Reuters melaporkan pertempuran Saudi-Houthi semakin sengit, dengan serangan Houthi mengenai kemudahan minyak dan lapangan terbang Saudi, termasuk di Riyadh, dan Saudi membalas dengan serangan udara. PBB menyatakan hampir 300,000 orang kehilangan tempat tinggal sejak Ogos.
summary.en: Four military sources cited by Reuters put the Houthis within 80km of Aden, their closest since 2015, threatening the road to besieged Taiz. Reuters says Saudi-Houthi fighting has intensified, with Houthi attacks hitting Saudi oil facilities and airports, including Riyadh's, and Saudi air strikes in response. The UN says nearly 300,000 people have been displaced since August.

title.bm: Houthi mara hingga 80km dari Aden, mengancam laluan sempit Laut Merah
title.en: Houthis advance to within 80km of Aden, threatening Red Sea chokepoint

why.bm: Bab Al Mandeb laluan penting eksport minyak Saudi ke Asia, jadi ancaman terhadap laluan sempit kedua selain Hormuz meningkatkan risiko tenaga dan perkapalan. Anwar menamakan Yaman dan Laut Merah antara ancaman yang sedang dipersiapkan oleh Malaysia.
why.en: Bab Al Mandeb is a key passage for Saudi oil exports to Asia, so a second chokepoint under threat on top of Hormuz raises energy and shipping risks. Anwar named Yemen and the Red Sea among the threats Malaysia is preparing for.

summary.bm: Selepas semua undi dikira, blok Netanyahu memperoleh 53 kerusi, pembangkang 48 dan senarai diterajui Arab mencatat rekod 19 kerusi, jadi tiada pihak mencapai 61 yang diperlukan. Bennett, Liberman, Golan dan Lapid bersetuju pada Selasa untuk mencadangkan Gadi Eisenkot kepada Presiden Herzog, yang memulakan rundingan hari ini; keputusan dijadual disahkan hari ini dan Knesset bersidang pada 10 Nov. Netanyahu mendakwa berlaku manipulasi, yang ditolak polis, namun siasatan Shin Bet diteruskan. Secara berasingan, Trump berkata bantuan tahunan AS $4 bilion akan tamat tahun ini manakala jualan senjata diteruskan, tanpa pengesahan Israel dilaporkan.
summary.en: With all votes counted, Netanyahu's bloc has 53 seats, the opposition 48 and Arab-led lists a record 19, leaving no one at the 61 needed. Bennett, Liberman, Golan and Lapid agreed on Tuesday to recommend Gadi Eisenkot to President Herzog, who starts consultations today; results are due to be certified today and the Knesset convenes on Nov 10. Netanyahu alleges manipulation, which police have dismissed, though a Shin Bet probe continues. Separately, Trump said the $4bn in annual US aid will end this year while arms sales continue, with no Israeli confirmation reported.

title.bm: Israel buntu selepas pilihan raya: pembangkang sokong Eisenkot, Netanyahu dakwa penipuan dan Trump kata bantuan $4 bilion akan ditamatkan
title.en: Israel deadlocked after election: opposition backs Eisenkot, Netanyahu claims fraud and Trump says $4bn aid will end

why.bm: Siapa yang memerintah Israel akan menentukan arah perang Iran, Gaza dan Lubnan, sekali gus kestabilan rantau dan harga minyak yang memberi kesan kepada kos di Malaysia.
why.en: Who governs Israel will shape the Iran war, Gaza and Lebanon, and so regional stability and the oil prices that feed into Malaysian costs.

summary.bm: Reuters melaporkan serangan Israel membunuh sekurang-kurangnya tiga orang di Gaza pada Isnin, dengan pegawai kesihatan mencatatkan sekurang-kurangnya 1,580 rakyat Palestin terbunuh sejak gencatan senjata bermula. Rundingan tersekat tentang pelucutan senjata Hamas dan pengunduran Israel, dan Israel menguasai kira-kira dua pertiga wilayah itu. Di Lubnan, Maariv melaporkan rancangan Israel yang mungkin menduduki Tyre, Sidon dan Nabatieh jika Hizbullah menyertai perang Iran yang bersambung semula, dan sumber menteri Lubnan berkata perang baharu tidak boleh diketepikan.
summary.en: Reuters reports Israeli strikes killed at least three in Gaza on Monday, with health officials counting at least 1,580 Palestinians killed since the ceasefire began. Talks are stuck on Hamas disarmament and Israeli withdrawal, and Israel controls about two-thirds of the territory. In Lebanon, Maariv reported Israeli plans to possibly occupy Tyre, Sidon and Nabatieh if Hezbollah joins a renewed Iran war, and Lebanese ministerial sources say another war cannot be ruled out.

title.bm: Serangan Israel di Gaza semakin kerap ketika gencatan senjata setahun buntu; Lubnan bimbang perang baharu jika pertempuran Iran bersambung
title.en: Israeli strikes intensify in Gaza as year-old truce stalls; Lebanon fears a new war if Iran fighting resumes

why.bm: Gaza kekal teras dasar luar Malaysia, dan Anwar menyebut pendirian tentang Palestin sebagai antara sebab Malaysia boleh berdepan serangan siber.
why.en: Gaza remains central to Malaysian foreign policy, and Anwar cited Palestine as one reason Malaysia could face cyberattacks.

summary.bm: China berkata pada Sabtu ia menghantar satu lagi rondaan pengawal pantai di pantai timur Taiwan dan akan mempergiat rondaan di perairan yang dituntutnya. AP melaporkan pertembungan berhampiran Kepulauan Pratas di Laut China Selatan, dengan kapal kira-kira 1 batu nautika dari satu sama lain, pencerobohan ke-13 seumpamanya di sana tahun ini melibatkan 16 kapal. Reuters memetik ketua hal ehwal lautan Taiwan yang berkata pulau itu mesti meninjau perairannya sendiri ketika kapal penyelidikan China beroperasi berdekatan.
summary.en: China said on Saturday it sent another coast guard patrol off Taiwan's east coast and would intensify patrols in waters it claims. AP reports a standoff near the Pratas Islands in the South China Sea, with ships about 1 nautical mile apart, the 13th such intrusion there this year involving 16 vessels. Reuters quoted Taiwan's ocean affairs chief saying the island must survey its own waters as Chinese research ships probe nearby.

title.bm: Taiwan tuduh China tingkatkan gangguan pengawal pantai, termasuk di pantai timur dan berhampiran Pratas
title.en: Taiwan accuses China of stepping up coast guard harassment, including off its east coast and near Pratas

why.bm: Tekanan pengawal pantai di Laut China Selatan seiring dengan apa yang dihadapi Malaysia di luar pantai Sarawak, dan sebarang krisis Taiwan akan menjejaskan rantaian bekalan cip yang menjadi sandaran Malaysia.
why.en: Coast guard pressure in the South China Sea mirrors what Malaysia faces off Sarawak, and any Taiwan crisis would hit the chip supply chains Malaysia depends on.

summary.bm: Sudan mengemukakan aduan kepada Majlis Keselamatan PBB dan Kesatuan Afrika, mencatatkan 70 serangan dengan 187 dron yang didakwanya dilancarkan dari wilayah Ethiopia antara Februari dan Oktober, 97 daripadanya pada Oktober sahaja. Ia melaporkan 484 orang awam dan 176 askar terbunuh serta lebih 90% stesen janakuasa bandar lumpuh. Ethiopia menafikan menyokong RSF, dan penganalisis memberitahu Al Jazeera bahawa kebimbangan terhadap peningkatan konflik serantau setakat ini menghalang pertempuran terbuka.
summary.en: Sudan has complained to the UN Security Council and African Union, counting 70 assaults with 187 drones it says were launched from Ethiopian territory between February and October, 97 of them in October alone. It reports 484 civilians and 176 soldiers killed and over 90% of city power stations out of service. Ethiopia denies backing the RSF, and analysts told Al Jazeera that fear of regional escalation is so far preventing open conflict.

title.bm: Sudan bawa Ethiopia ke PBB atas serangan dron RSF, mencetuskan kebimbangan perang lebih luas
title.en: Sudan takes Ethiopia to the UN over RSF drone attacks, raising fears of a wider war

why.bm: Krisis pelarian melibatkan kira-kira 13 juta orang boleh merebak ke seluruh Tanduk Afrika, bersebelahan laluan perkapalan Laut Merah yang sama.
why.en: A displacement crisis of about 13 million people could spread across the Horn of Africa, next to the same Red Sea shipping routes.

summary.bm: Pada dagangan Asia kemudiannya, The National melaporkan Nikkei turun 3.5%, Kospi turun 3.6%, niaga hadapan S&P 500 turun kira-kira 1.06% dan niaga hadapan Nasdaq 100 turun 1.9%, manakala Reuters lebih awal melaporkan Kioxia susut kira-kira 10% dan SoftBank kira-kira 7%. Dolar melemah dan hasil bon 10 tahun AS turun kepada kira-kira 4.89%. Penganalisis yang dipetik Reuters berbeza pandangan sama ada penurunan ini berlebihan, dan Tai Hui dari JPMorgan menyatakan kuasa veto Trump mengehadkan pengaruh Demokrat. Bank of England dijangka menaikkan kadar pada Khamis, kali pertama sejak Ogos 2023.
summary.en: Later in Asian trade, The National reported the Nikkei down 3.5%, the Kospi down 3.6%, S&P 500 futures down about 1.06% and Nasdaq 100 futures down 1.9%, while Reuters earlier had Kioxia off about 10% and SoftBank about 7%. The dollar fell and the US 10-year yield dropped to about 4.89%. Analysts quoted by Reuters split on whether the move is overdone, and JPMorgan's Tai Hui noted Trump's veto limits Democratic influence. The Bank of England is expected to raise rates on Thursday for the first time since August 2023.

title.bm: Saham Asia merosot apabila kemenangan besar Demokrat menekan saham AI dan cip; Nikkei turun kira-kira 3.5%, Bank of England dijangka naikkan kadar Khamis
title.en: Asian stocks slide as Democratic sweep hits AI and chip names; Nikkei down about 3.5%, Bank of England expected to hike Thursday

why.bm: Dolar yang lebih lemah menyokong ringgit, manakala tekanan terhadap saham AI memberi kesan kepada saham teknologi dan pusat data di Bursa.
why.en: A softer dollar supports the ringgit, while pressure on AI stocks matters for Bursa's tech and data-centre names.

summary.bm: Bank pusat Australia menaikkan kadar tunai 25 mata asas kepada 4.85% melalui undian 6-3, kenaikan kelima tahun ini, dengan alasan inflasi yang meluas dan permintaan pelaburan didorong AI. Bank of England dijangka mula menaikkan kadar pada Khamis, dan Riksbank Sweden dijangka bergerak ke 2.00% hari ini. CME FedWatch menunjukkan peluang 78% Fed menaikkan kadar pada Disember, menurut Reuters.
summary.en: Australia's central bank raised its cash rate 25bp to 4.85% in a 6-3 vote, its fifth hike this year, citing broadly based inflation and AI-driven investment demand. The Bank of England is expected to start hiking on Thursday, and Sweden's Riksbank is expected to move to 2.00% today. CME FedWatch showed a 78% chance of a Fed rate hike in December, per Reuters.

title.bm: Kenaikan kadar merebak: RBA naikkan kepada 4.85%, Bank of England dijangka menyusul dan pasaran bertaruh Fed naikkan kadar Disember
title.en: Rate hikes spread: RBA lifts to 4.85%, Bank of England expected to follow as markets bet on a December Fed hike

why.bm: Kitaran pengetatan global menambah tekanan terhadap Bank Negara dan kos pinjaman rakyat Malaysia.
why.en: A global tightening cycle raises pressure on Bank Negara and on borrowing costs for Malaysians.

summary.bm: PMI pembuatan rasmi China turun kepada 49.3 pada Oktober daripada 50.1, kembali menguncup, dan PMI bukan pembuatan menyusut kepada 49.7, manakala tolok swasta RatingDog kekal 52.0. CSI 300 jatuh 8.5% pada Oktober selepas rekod 12 minggu berturut-turut kerugian. Mulai 2 Nov PBOC melaksanakan repo berbalik semalaman harian pada 1.25%, dan Cailian melaporkan pengawal selia akan membincangkan sokongan pasaran saham, tanpa pengesahan rasmi.
summary.en: China's official manufacturing PMI fell to 49.3 in October from 50.1, back in contraction, and the non-manufacturing PMI slipped to 49.7, while the private RatingDog gauge held at 52.0. The CSI 300 fell 8.5% in October after a record 12 straight weekly losses. From Nov 2 the PBOC is running daily overnight reverse repos at 1.25%, and Cailian reported regulators would discuss stock support, with no official confirmation.

title.bm: Aktiviti kilang China menguncup semula dan saham memasuki pasaran menurun ketika PBOC beralih kepada kadar semalaman
title.en: China's factory activity shrinks again and stocks enter a bear market as the PBOC shifts toward an overnight rate

why.bm: China rakan dagang terbesar Malaysia, jadi permintaan yang lemah di sana memberi kesan kepada eksport, minyak sawit dan harga komoditi.
why.en: China is Malaysia's largest trading partner, so weaker demand there matters for exports, palm oil and commodity prices.

summary.bm: Kira-kira 100 kedai di beberapa negara mendapati peti sejuk dan penyejuk beku menjadi panas pada Isnin, termasuk Carrefour, Delhaize dan Coop. Tiada kumpulan mengaku bertanggungjawab, dan pendakwa Belgium membuka siasatan jenayah. Reuters melaporkan nasihat kepada penduduk EU, Kanada dan Jepun supaya menyimpan stok makanan selepas serangan siber terhadap infrastruktur digital.
summary.en: About 100 shops in several countries had fridges and freezers running hot on Monday, with Carrefour, Delhaize and Coop among those affected. No group has claimed responsibility, and Belgian prosecutors have opened a criminal probe. Reuters reports advisories telling people in the EU, Canada and Japan to stockpile food after cyberattacks on digital infrastructure.

title.bm: Penggodam serang penyejuk beku pasar raya di Eropah; EU anggap serangan sengaja terhadap bekalan makanan
title.en: Hackers hit supermarket freezers across Europe; EU sees deliberate attack on food supply

why.bm: Serangan kini sampai ke sistem fizikal, bukan sekadar data. Sistem kawalan bangunan dan penyejukan yang bersambung turut terdedah, sesuatu yang penting bagi pengendali rangkaian dan fasiliti.
why.en: Attacks are now reaching physical systems, not just data. Connected building and cooling controls are exposed, which is relevant to anyone running networks and facilities.

summary.bm: Selepas mesyuarat khas Majlis Keselamatan Negara pada 2 Nov, Anwar memberitahu Parlimen bahawa Ketua Setiausaha Negara dan Gabenor Bank Negara akan mengadakan mesyuarat berasingan dengan jabatan kerajaan dan institusi kewangan. Beliau menyebut kekuatan pusat data Malaysia dan pendiriannya tentang Palestin sebagai sebab negara ini boleh menjadi sasaran, serta mencadangkan taklimat tertutup kepada semua Ahli Parlimen dalam sehari dua jika kedua-dua pihak bersetuju. Timbalan Perdana Menteri Zahid berkata stok makanan mencukupi sekurang-kurangnya enam bulan dan orang ramai tidak perlu membeli secara panik; Nacsa memantau sistem setiap hari, dan polis menyiasat dakwaan penggodaman lapan skrin LED Majlis Perbandaran Kluang.
summary.en: After a special National Security Council meeting on Nov 2, Anwar told Parliament the Chief Secretary and the central bank governor will hold separate meetings with government departments and financial institutions. He cited Malaysia's data-centre strength and its stance on Palestine as reasons it could be targeted, and proposed a closed-door briefing for all MPs within a day or two if both sides agree. Deputy PM Zahid said food reserves cover at least six months and urged no panic-buying; Nacsa is monitoring systems daily, and police are probing an alleged hack of eight Kluang council LED screens.

title.bm: Anwar beri amaran Malaysia boleh jadi sasaran serangan siber; pegawai tertinggi dan bank bermesyuarat, Zahid kata stok makanan cukup enam bulan
title.en: Anwar warns Malaysia could be a cyberattack target; top officials and banks meet as Zahid says food reserves cover six months

why.bm: Jangkakan arahan dan latihan lebih ketat untuk infrastruktur kritikal, bank dan agensi kerajaan, yang berkait langsung dengan operasi IT dan rangkaian.
why.en: Expect tighter directives and drills for critical infrastructure, banks and government agencies, which bears directly on IT and network operations.

summary.bm: Konsensus menjangkakan OPR kekal 2.75%, namun sesetengah ahli ekonomi berhujah untuk normalisasi selepas pertumbuhan KDNK mencecah 5.5% bagi sembilan bulan pertama 2026. Ringgit dibuka pada 4.0730 dan KLCI berada pada 1,619.43 pada sesi pagi, turun 2.42 mata, ketika sentimen berhati-hati menekan pasaran serantau. BMI menjangkakan kadar kekal pada Khamis dan tiada perubahan sepanjang 2027.
summary.en: Consensus expects the OPR to stay at 2.75%, but some economists argue for normalisation after GDP growth reached 5.5% in the first nine months of 2026. The ringgit opened at 4.0730 and the KLCI was at 1,619.43 in the morning session, down 2.42 points, as caution weighed on regional markets. BMI expects a hold on Thursday and no change through 2027.

title.bm: Keputusan kadar Bank Negara pada Khamis; ringgit sekitar 4.07 atas jangkaan kenaikan
title.en: Bank Negara rate decision on Thursday; ringgit near 4.07 on hike bets

why.bm: Kenaikan mengejut akan meningkatkan bayaran balik pinjaman dan gadai janji serta mengukuhkan ringgit.
why.en: A surprise hike would raise loan and mortgage repayments and lift the ringgit.

summary.bm: Anwar memberitahu Parlimen bahawa RM8.3 bilion, atau 88% nilai kontrak, dibayar untuk kemajuan fizikal hanya 13% bagi projek yang diluluskan pada 2016 tanpa tender terbuka. Penstrukturan semula dengan China Exim Bank yang ditandatangani pada 30 Okt melibatkan RM5 bilion, yang menurut beliau mengurangkan anggaran kerugian daripada RM8 bilion kepada RM3 bilion dan akan membiayai skim air Perak–Pulau Pinang. Siasatan SPRM diteruskan.
summary.en: Anwar told Parliament that RM8.3bn, or 88% of the contract value, was paid for only 13% physical progress on the projects awarded in 2016 without open tender. A restructuring signed with China Exim Bank on Oct 30 covers RM5bn, which he says cuts the estimated loss from RM8bn to RM3bn and will fund a Perak–Penang water scheme. The MACC probe continues.

title.bm: Anwar: salah laku serius dalam projek paip Sabah RM9.4 bilion; pinjaman RM5 bilion distruktur semula
title.en: Anwar: serious misconduct in RM9.4bn Sabah pipeline deals; RM5bn loan restructured

why.bm: Pembayar cukai masih menanggung hutang yang dijamin, dan RM5 bilion itu disalurkan semula kepada bekalan air negeri utara melalui tender terbuka.
why.en: Taxpayers still carry the guaranteed debt, and the RM5bn is being redirected into water supply for northern states under open tender.

summary.bm: Penamaan calon bagi 28 kerusi Melaka berlangsung pada 31 Okt, dengan pengundian pada 14 Nov; BN dan PH masing-masing dilaporkan bertanding 21 kerusi, dan Bersama pimpinan Rafizi menamakan 15 calon. DUN Sarawak dengan 82 kerusi dibubarkan pada 26 Okt, dan SPR bermesyuarat pada 6 Nov untuk menetapkan tarikh, yang mesti dalam tempoh 60 hari selepas pembubaran. PH kehilangan pengaruh di Johor pada Julai dan kedudukannya di Negeri Sembilan tertekan, manakala Anwar mesti mengadakan PRU selewat-lewatnya Februari 2028.
summary.en: Nominations for Melaka's 28 seats closed on Oct 31, with polling on Nov 14; BN and PH were each reported to be contesting 21, and Rafizi's Bersama named 15 candidates. Sarawak's 82-seat assembly was dissolved on Oct 26, and the Election Commission meets on Nov 6 to set dates, which must fall within 60 days of dissolution. PH lost ground in Johor in July and its hold on Negeri Sembilan has come under pressure, while Anwar must call a general election by February 2028.

title.bm: Melaka mengundi 14 Nov dan tarikh Sarawak ditetapkan Jumaat ini, dua PRN menguji Anwar
title.en: Melaka votes Nov 14 and Sarawak dates are set this Friday, as twin state polls test Anwar

why.bm: Keputusan ini akan menentukan hubungan PH–BN dan masa PRU16, dan Apex Securities menyebutnya sebagai punca ketidaktentuan pasaran.
why.en: These results will shape PH–BN ties and GE16 timing, and Apex Securities cites them as a source of market uncertainty.

summary.bm: Kementerian Dalam Negeri memberitahu Parlimen suruhanjaya diraja tidak diketepikan jika ada asas yang jelas, ketika Op Viking merakam keterangan 70 orang dan membekukan aset melebihi RM409 juta, termasuk 417 akaun CDS dan 404 akaun bank. Ia tidak menamakan suspek atau memberi tempoh siasatan. Rafizi Ramli, kini pemimpin Bersama, dipanggil pada 3 Nov di bawah peruntukan fitnah dan khianat awam berhubung dakwaannya, membatalkan program kempen di Melaka dan berkata kerajaan cuba menakut-nakutkannya; Ramanan dari PKR menafikan dakwaan rasuah itu.
summary.en: The Home Ministry told Parliament a royal commission is not ruled out if there is a clear basis, as Op Viking has recorded statements from 70 people and frozen over RM409m in assets, including 417 CDS accounts and 404 bank accounts. It named no suspects and gave no timeline. Rafizi Ramli, now Bersama's leader, was summoned on Nov 3 under defamation and public mischief provisions over his claims, cancelled a Melaka campaign event, and says the government is intimidating him; PKR's Ramanan denies the bribery allegation.

title.bm: Putrajaya terbuka kepada RCI tentang dakwaan 'mafia korporat'; polis bekukan RM409 juta, Rafizi dipanggil Bukit Aman
title.en: Putrajaya open to RCI on 'corporate mafia' claims; police freeze RM409m as Rafizi is called in by Bukit Aman

why.bm: Dakwaan bahawa kuasa penguatkuasaan disalah guna untuk memaksa penjualan saham menyentuh keyakinan pelabur terhadap pasaran dan institusi Malaysia.
why.en: The claim that enforcement powers were misused to force share sales goes to investor confidence in Malaysia's markets and institutions.

summary.bm: Timbalan Perdana Menteri merangkap Menteri Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah itu berkata terdapat arahan membatalkan semua Surat Setuju Terima yang telah atau akan dikeluarkan bagi projek tersebut, dan beliau boleh menunjukkan dokumennya. Pertikaian bermula apabila Ahli Parlimen Jelutong RSN Rayer menuduhnya di Dewan Rakyat pada 2 Nov cuba mensabotaj Kerajaan Madani.
summary.en: The Deputy PM and rural minister said there were instructions to cancel all letters of acceptance issued or due for these projects, and that he can show the documents. The row began when Jelutong MP RSN Rayer accused him in the Dewan Rakyat on Nov 2 of trying to sabotage the Madani government.

title.bm: Zahid nafi sabotaj kerajaan, kata ada dokumen projek luar bandar Sabah dan Sarawak dibatalkan
title.en: Zahid denies sabotaging the government, says he has documents on cancelled Sabah and Sarawak rural projects

why.bm: Pertelingkahan terbuka antara rakan gabungan, ketika Sarawak bakal mengundi, menguji Kerajaan Perpaduan dan pelaksanaan projek luar bandar di Borneo.
why.en: A public clash between coalition partners, with Sarawak about to vote, tests the unity government and the delivery of Borneo rural projects.

summary.bm: Menteri Kewangan II Amir Hamzah memberitahu Dewan Rakyat bahawa setakat 31 Okt, individu menerima RM6.84 bilion melibatkan 3.4 juta pembayar cukai manakala syarikat, termasuk PMKS, RM13.04 bilion melibatkan 206,234 pembayar. Pembayar cukai dengan lebihan kredit cukai berkurang kepada kira-kira 550,000 daripada lebih 1 juta pada akhir 2025.
summary.en: Finance Minister II Amir Hamzah told the Dewan Rakyat that as at Oct 31 individuals received RM6.84bn across 3.4m taxpayers and companies, including MSMEs, RM13.04bn across 206,234. Taxpayers with excess tax credits fell to about 550,000 from more than 1m at end-2025.

title.bm: Kerajaan bayar RM20.27 bilion bayaran balik cukai pendapatan setakat ini, melibatkan 3.65 juta kes
title.en: Government has paid RM20.27bn in income tax refunds this year, covering 3.65m cases

why.bm: Bayaran balik yang lambat menjadi masalah aliran tunai kepada perniagaan kecil dan pekerja bergaji, jadi tunggakan yang berkurang memberi kelegaan langsung.
why.en: Slow refunds have been a cash-flow problem for small firms and salaried workers, so a shrinking backlog is a direct relief.

summary.bm: Syarikat di sebalik Claude melaporkan hasil Q3 hampir $17 bilion, kira-kira 12 kali ganda berbanding setahun lalu, tetapi mencatat kerugian operasi $567 juta selepas pendapatan operasi $974 juta pada Q2, dengan alasan pengkomputeran jangka pendek $5 bilion. Komitmen pengkomputeran dan infrastruktur berjumlah kira-kira $895 bilion, hampir separuh dijangka menjelang akhir 2030. Pemfailan itu dilaporkan memberi amaran Claude mungkin tidak lama lagi mencapai ambang peningkatan kendiri rekursif Anthropic, dan WSJ melaporkan pembeli IPO menekan penilaian kepada $1.5–1.6 trilion daripada $2 trilion.
summary.en: Claude's maker reported Q3 revenue of nearly $17bn, roughly 12 times a year earlier, but swung to a $567m operating loss after $974m of operating income in Q2, citing $5bn of short-term compute. Compute and infrastructure commitments total about $895bn, with nearly half expected by end-2030. The filing reportedly warns Claude may soon reach Anthropic's recursive self-improvement threshold, and the WSJ reported IPO buyers pushing the valuation to $1.5–1.6tn from $2tn.

title.bm: Pemfailan IPO pindaan Anthropic dedah hasil Q3 hampir $17 bilion dan komitmen pengkomputeran $895 bilion
title.en: Anthropic's amended IPO filing shows nearly $17bn Q3 revenue and $895bn in compute commitments

why.bm: Ini gambaran awam paling jelas setakat ini tentang kos AI termaju, dan kos itu mempengaruhi harga serta had penggunaan bagi pengguna Claude. Sambutan IPO yang lemah turut akan menguji pasaran AI secara keseluruhan.
why.en: It is the clearest public view yet of what frontier AI costs, and those costs shape pricing and usage limits for everyday Claude users. A weak IPO reception would also test the wider AI trade.

summary.bm: FT melaporkan OpenAI mengurangkan pusingan pembiayaannya kepada $20 bilion daripada $30 bilion sebelum ini, pada penilaian $1.25 trilion, dan WSJ menyatakan kira-kira $11 bilion telah diperoleh selepas sambutan hambar daripada sesetengah pelabur besar. Secara berasingan, OpenAI memberitahu pengguna ia akan menggabungkan tab Chat dan Work dalam aplikasi desktop ChatGPT, bermula dengan pengguna terpilih. ChatGPT dan Codex akan berkongsi satu kumpulan had penggunaan; OpenAI berkata kebanyakan pengguna tidak terjejas, walaupun sesetengahnya mungkin lebih kerap perlu menunggu had ditetapkan semula.
summary.en: The FT reported OpenAI lowered its round to $20bn from an earlier $30bn, at a $1.25tn valuation, and the WSJ said about $11bn is secured after a tepid response from some large investors. Separately, OpenAI told users it will merge the Chat and Work tabs in the ChatGPT desktop app, rolling out first to select users. ChatGPT and Codex will draw on one usage pool; OpenAI says most users won't be affected, though some may hit resets more often.

title.bm: OpenAI kurangkan sasaran pembiayaan kepada $20 bilion; tab Chat dan Work ChatGPT akan digabung, had dikongsi dengan Codex
title.en: OpenAI cuts its funding target to $20bn; ChatGPT's Chat and Work tabs to merge, with limits shared with Codex

why.bm: Pelabur semakin berhati-hati terhadap perbelanjaan AI ketika dua makmal utama menuju pasaran awam. Pelanggan berbayar ChatGPT yang turut menggunakan Codex mungkin lebih cepat mencapai had.
why.en: Investors are getting more cautious on AI spending just as both leading labs head for the public markets. Paid ChatGPT users who also use Codex may notice limits sooner.

summary.bm: Google berkata Gemini 4 Carbon, model terkuatnya untuk kejuruteraan jangka panjang dan pertahanan siber, sedang diuji secara terhad dengan kerajaan AS dan pakar pertahanan dipercayai sebelum dikeluarkan lebih meluas. Penasihat Mahkamah Keadilan EU berkata jawapan Gemini mungkin melanggar hak penerbit jika ia memintas paywall atau menggunakan semula ungkapan yang boleh dikenali, walaupun latihan model dilindungi pengecualian perlombongan teks dan data; pendapat itu tidak mengikat. Google memaklumkan pelanggan AI Plus ($4.99 sebulan) bahawa model Pro ditarik mulai 13 Nov, tinggal Flash dan Flash-Lite.
summary.en: Google says Gemini 4 Carbon, its strongest model for long-horizon engineering and cyber defence, is in limited testing with the US government and trusted defenders before wider release. An EU Court of Justice adviser said Gemini's answers may infringe publishers' rights if it bypasses paywalls or reuses recognisable expression, though training is covered by the text and data mining exception; the opinion is non-binding. Google is emailing AI Plus subscribers ($4.99 a month) that Pro models go from Nov 13, leaving Flash and Flash-Lite.

title.bm: Google uji Gemini 4 Carbon dengan kerajaan AS; penasihat mahkamah EU sebelahi penerbit, AI Plus hilang model Pro
title.en: Google tests Gemini 4 Carbon with US government; EU court adviser sides with publishers, and AI Plus loses Pro models

why.bm: Keputusan itu boleh mengubah cara chatbot menggunakan kandungan berita, dan pengguna Malaysia pada pelan murah AI Plus akan merasai penurunan yang nyata.
why.en: The ruling could reshape how chatbots use news content, and Malaysian users on the cheap AI Plus tier will notice a real downgrade.

summary.bm: Bloomberg melaporkan pasukan Harness DeepSeek melancarkan mod pencipta untuk membina pemalam dengan bahasa biasa dan pembantu pengekodan dipertingkat yang menyasarkan perkhidmatan seperti Anthropic, selepas mengumpul kira-kira 100 bilion yuan ($15 bilion) menjelang IPO yang dirancang. Ia juga menjadikan dsh-superagent sumber terbuka, prototaip penyelidikan yang menerima tugasan melalui sembang pasukan dan GitHub. KuCoin News, dalam laporan yang atribusinya tidak konsisten, menyatakan gangguan 3 Nov menjejaskan sembang serta API V4 Pro dan V4.1 Flash, insiden besar ke-19 pada 2026.
summary.en: Bloomberg reports DeepSeek's Harness team launched a creator mode for building plugins from plain English and an enhanced coding assistant aimed at services like Anthropic's, after raising about 100bn yuan ($15bn) ahead of a planned IPO. It also open-sourced dsh-superagent, a research prototype that takes work from team chat and GitHub. KuCoin News, in a report with inconsistent attribution, says a Nov 3 outage hit chat and the V4 Pro and V4.1 Flash APIs, its 19th major incident of 2026.

title.bm: DeepSeek ceburi ejen AI dengan mod pencipta dan ejen pengekodan sumber terbuka, tetapi alami gangguan lagi
title.en: DeepSeek pushes into AI agents with creator mode and an open-source coding agent, but suffers another outage

why.bm: Ejen China yang murah menambah persaingan alat pengekodan, namun gangguan berulang menunjukkan kekurangan kuasa pengkomputeran yang mengehadkan makmal China.
why.en: Cheap Chinese agents add competition for coding tools, but repeated outages show the compute shortage limiting Chinese labs.

summary.bm: Moonshot berjanji menerbitkan pemberat model 3 trilion parameter itu selewat-lewatnya 4 Nov; laporan yang disemak belum dapat mengesahkan ia telah dikeluarkan. Artificial Analysis meletakkannya di tempat pertama dalam kalangan model pemberat terbuka dan keempat keseluruhan, dengan harga API $2 input dan $10 output bagi sejuta token. Dakwaan promosi berbayar oleh pempengaruh tanpa pendedahan masih belum disahkan.
summary.en: Moonshot promised to publish the weights of the 3-trillion-parameter model by Nov 4; the reports reviewed could not confirm they are out yet. Artificial Analysis ranks it first among open-weights models and fourth overall, with an API price of $2 input and $10 output per million tokens. Allegations of undisclosed paid influencer promotion remain unverified.

title.bm: Tarikh akhir Moonshot untuk pemberat terbuka Kimi K3.1 Pro jatuh hari ini; pelepasan belum disahkan
title.en: Moonshot's deadline for Kimi K3.1 Pro open weights falls today; release not yet confirmed

why.bm: Pemberat terbuka yang hampir setaraf model termaju membolehkan syarikat menjalankan model kuat pada perkakasan sendiri tanpa bergantung pada API AS atau China, sesuatu yang penting bagi firma Malaysia yang sensitif tentang data.
why.en: Open weights near the frontier would let companies run a strong model on their own hardware rather than rely on US or Chinese hosted APIs, which matters for data-sensitive Malaysian firms.

summary.bm: FT, memetik lima sumber, melaporkan Nvidia meminta pelanggan awan menjual sekurang-kurangnya 51% perkhidmatan mereka kepada syarikat bukan China, satu arahan yang disampaikan secara lisan oleh pasukan jualannya. Sebelum ini Nvidia tidak mengenakan sekatan sedemikian. Banyak firma China menggunakan pengkomputeran awan luar negara untuk latihan AI, dan langkah ini menyusuli usaha AS mengehadkan akses kepada cip termaju melalui perjanjian awan.
summary.en: The FT, citing five people, reported that Nvidia told cloud clients to sell at least 51% of their services to non-Chinese companies, an instruction given verbally by its sales teams. Nvidia previously had no such restriction. Many Chinese firms use overseas cloud computing for AI training, and the move follows US efforts to limit access to advanced chips through cloud deals.

title.bm: Nvidia minta rakan pusat data kurangkan pendedahan kepada China, lapor FT
title.en: Nvidia tells data-centre partners to cut Chinese exposure, FT reports

why.bm: Mana-mana pengendali pusat data Malaysia yang banyak pelanggan China boleh terjejas jika peraturan ini dikuatkuasakan di sini, sekali gus memberi kesan kepada cita-cita negara sebagai hab digital.
why.en: Any Malaysian data-centre operator with a large Chinese client base could be affected if the rule is applied here, which would matter for the country's digital hub ambitions.

summary.bm: FBI menyalahkan unit TraderTraitor Korea Utara; Kim Yo Jong menyifatkan dakwaan itu sebagai "retorik tidak masuk akal". Reuters menyatakan pelanggan mengeluarkan kira-kira $4.64 bilion selepas pengeluaran disambung semula pada 1 Nov, aliran keluar bersih kira-kira $3.64 bilion. Binance mengaitkan kemasukan penyerang dengan komputer riba jurutera DevOps yang dikompromi, berkata kira-kira 90–95% aset yang dicuri telah digantikan dengan dananya sendiri, dan rakan kongsi membekukan hampir $3 bilion pada hari pertama.
summary.en: The FBI blamed North Korea's TraderTraitor unit; Kim Yo Jong called the claim "absurd rhetoric". Reuters says customers withdrew about $4.64bn after withdrawals resumed on Nov 1, a net outflow of about $3.64bn. Binance traces entry to a DevOps engineer's compromised laptop, says it has covered about 90–95% of stolen assets from its own funds, and partners froze close to $3bn on day one.

title.bm: Korea Utara nafi kecurian Binance $6.3 bilion, mungkin terbesar dalam sejarah kripto, ketika pelanggan keluarkan berbilion dolar
title.en: North Korea denies $6.3bn Binance heist, likely the largest crypto theft ever, as customers pull billions

why.bm: Satu komputer riba yang dikompromi membawa kepada kecurian terbesar, pengajaran penting bagi pasukan IT tentang capaian istimewa. Pengguna Binance di Malaysia perlu berwaspada terhadap penipuan pampasan palsu.
why.en: A single compromised laptop led to a record theft, a hard lesson for any IT team on privileged access. Malaysian Binance users should watch for fake compensation scams.

summary.bm: Apple menganggarkan margin kasar suku Disember 45–46% berbanding 47.9%, sebahagiannya akibat kos Siri berkuasa AI, dan saham turun kira-kira 4% sebelum pasaran dibuka. Jualan iPhone suku itu $57.58 bilion mengatasi anggaran LSEG $56.54 bilion. CEO John Ternus berkata harga memori belum pernah berlaku sebelum ini, dan Forbes melaporkan beliau memberi amaran tentang tekanan terhadap harga.
summary.en: Apple guided December-quarter gross margin to 45–46% from 47.9%, partly on AI-powered Siri costs, and shares fell about 4% before the bell. Quarterly iPhone sales of $57.58bn beat the $56.54bn LSEG estimate. CEO John Ternus said memory pricing is unprecedented, and Forbes reports he warned of pressure on prices.

title.bm: Apple beri amaran kos memori 'belum pernah berlaku' dalam keputusan pertama Ternus; saham jatuh
title.en: Apple warns of 'unprecedented' memory costs in Ternus's first results; shares fall

why.bm: Permintaan AI terhadap memori menaikkan kos telefon dan komputer riba, jadi pembeli di Malaysia mungkin perlu membayar lebih.
why.en: AI demand for memory is pushing up the cost of phones and laptops, so everyday buyers in Malaysia may pay more.

summary.bm: Hasil Q3 meningkat 45% kepada $13.4 bilion dan jualan pusat data hampir dua kali ganda kepada rekod $8.5 bilion. Unjuran Q4 kira-kira $17 bilion, tambah atau tolak 3%, membayangkan pertumbuhan tahunan kira-kira 66%. Reuters melaporkan saham naik kira-kira 8%, dan keputusan itu menstabilkan dagangan AI sebelum keputusan pilihan raya AS menekan saham cip Asia.
summary.en: Q3 revenue rose 45% to $13.4bn and data-centre sales nearly doubled to a record $8.5bn. Q4 guidance of about $17bn, plus or minus 3%, implies roughly 66% annual growth. Reuters put the shares up about 8%, and the results steadied the AI trade before the US election results hit Asian chip stocks.

title.bm: AMD atasi jangkaan dengan hasil pusat data rekod, anggar Q4 kira-kira $17 bilion
title.en: AMD beats with record data-centre revenue and guides Q4 to about $17bn

why.bm: Permintaan kuat cip AI menyokong eksport pembungkusan dan ujian cip Malaysia, yang memacu lonjakan 69% penghantaran ke AS tahun ini.
why.en: Strong AI chip demand supports Malaysia's chip packaging and test exports, which drove a 69% jump in shipments to the US this year.

summary.bm: Akhbar Maeil Business Korea, yang dipetik Reuters, menyatakan keseluruhan keluaran kilang itu telah ditempah, kebanyakannya untuk AMD, menggunakan proses 2nm, dengan pembinaan bulan ini, peralatan mulai Februari 2029 dan pengeluaran besar-besaran pada 2030. Tiada syarikat mengesahkan tempahan itu, dan Samsung enggan mengulas.
summary.en: Korea's Maeil Business Newspaper, relayed by Reuters, says the plant's entire output is ordered, mostly for AMD, using a 2nm process, with construction this month, equipment from February 2029 and mass production in 2030. None of the companies has confirmed the orders, and Samsung declined to comment.

title.bm: Samsung dilaporkan tempah kilang kedua Texas untuk cip asas memori AMD dan Nvidia
title.en: Samsung reportedly books second Texas fab for AMD and Nvidia memory base dies

why.bm: Memori lebar jalur tinggi menjadi kekangan utama perkakasan AI dan kenaikan harga peranti; kapasiti tambahan hanya tiba menjelang hujung dekad.
why.en: High-bandwidth memory is the bottleneck behind AI hardware and higher device prices; more capacity arrives only near the end of the decade.

summary.bm: Digitimes, memetik sumber rantaian bekalan, menyatakan rundingan sedang disediakan supaya TSMC memikul tanggungjawab utama membina dan mengendalikan kilang di Texas itu, berbeza dengan ikrar Musk pada 7 Okt bahawa pihaknya sendiri akan membina dan mengendalikannya. TSMC mengakui ada rundingan, dan CEO C.C. Wei pernah berkata mana-mana kilang melibatkan TSMC mesti dikendalikan TSMC. Laporan ini belum disahkan.
summary.en: Digitimes, citing supply-chain sources, says talks are being prepared for TSMC to take main responsibility for building and running the Texas fab, a reversal from Musk's Oct 7 vow that "we will build and run the fab". TSMC has acknowledged talks, and CEO C.C. Wei has said any fab involving TSMC must be operated by TSMC. The report is unconfirmed.

title.bm: Musk dilaporkan berlembut tentang Terafab dan mungkin benarkan TSMC mengendalikannya, lapor Digitimes
title.en: Musk reportedly softens on Terafab and may let TSMC run it, Digitimes says

why.bm: Ini menunjukkan betapa sukarnya menghasilkan cip termaju tanpa TSMC, sekali gus mengekalkan Taiwan sebagai pusat bekalan teknologi global.
why.en: It shows how hard it is to build leading-edge chips outside TSMC, which keeps Taiwan at the centre of global tech supply.

note.bm: Dijangka kekal 2.75%; kenaikan akan menjadi kejutan.
note.en: Hold at 2.75% expected; a hike would be a surprise.

title.en: Bank Negara OPR decision

note.bm: Dijangka menaikkan kadar buat kali pertama sejak Ogos 2023.
note.en: Expected to raise rates for the first time since August 2023.

title.en: EC sets Sarawak election dates
